name: beat01
set:
Flat vector animation for a mobile explainer: simple geometric shapes, flat fills with no gradients, thin light outlines, a dark navy and teal palette with one warm amber accent, minimal detail, clean and graphic, smooth motion-graphics movement. England, 1902.

subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is Mr White: a thin man of sixty with a bald crown, grey hair at the sides, a long grey moustache and small round spectacles, in a dark green knitted cardigan over a white collarless shirt, brown trousers and slippers.
<Picture 2> is Herbert: a tall cheerful young man of twenty-two with tousled chestnut hair, clean-shaven, in a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a mustard waistcoat and dark trousers.
<Picture 3> is the place, the parlour: a small Victorian parlour at night: a brick fireplace with a burning fire on the right, a tall sash window streaming with rain on the left, a round wooden table with a chessboard and an oil lamp in the middle, two wooden chairs, a worn armchair, faded patterned wallpaper, a door to the hall at the back.

Scene overview: A quiet evening at home while a storm beats on the house. Everyone and everything looks as in the pictures.

Storyboard:
[0.0s-5.7s] Shot 1: seen from outside through the rain-streaked window, the camera slowly pushes in to the parlour, where Mr White and Herbert sit over a chessboard by the fire; Herbert moves a piece and grins, Mr White frowns at the board and strokes his moustache.

Audio: heavy rain on glass, a fire crackling, the click of a chess piece. No speech, no narration, no singing and no music.

No text, captions, subtitles, logos or watermarks anywhere. Vertical frame: faces and the main action stay in the upper two thirds.
